weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_pr.classification_evidence: Week-blocked 95% [-2.6882, +0.5953] and season-blocked [-3.4392, +0.9381] BOTH contain zero, so no admissible closing ground is met on the primary endpoint: the sign is not resolved, and no positive control bounded it. Recorded unresolved per AGENTS.md rather than called a failure. It nonetheless leans hard against the candidate (P+ 0.0956 week-blocked, 0.1629 season-blocked), which is what decides the PLAY on expected value: keeping the incumbent is the ~90/10 favoured side. Reliability is not_applicable -- this is a whole-profile comparison, not a per-team trait with a year-over-year value to split-half.
weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_pr.description: weak_stack_v4 (production weak_stack + 6 continuous forecast-weather columns from the completed kickoff-nearest archive) vs the active weak_stack profile, PRIMARY endpoint: paired forced-pick accuracy delta at the OPENER grade under the production probability rule. Both arms hold ridge_alpha=10.0 and regressor=ridge fixed; only feature_profile differs. Baseline 53.36% (matches the tracked production figure exactly), candidate 52.30%, on 1,537 paired Tuesday-opener games over 107 weeks / 2020-2025. Predeclared in docs/weak_stack_v4.md before scoring.
weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_pr.plain_summary: Model setting: six raw weather-forecast numbers added.

weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_si.classification_evidence: The ENTIRE week-blocked interval [-3.3467, -0.5940] sits below zero, and the season-blocked interval [-3.2720, -0.8291] does too, with P+ 0.00255 and 0.0 respectively. That is a RESOLVED wrong sign on this endpoint -- the admissible closing ground wrong_sign_resolved -- not an interval-contains-zero rejection. Paired Brier and log-loss at the opener agree and also exclude zero (-0.001574 [-0.002839, -0.000336] P+ 0.0064; -0.003192 [-0.005787, -0.000648] P+ 0.0071), so the probability quality moved the same way as the picks. Scope of this closure is EXACTLY this construction: six continuous forecast columns added to a ~275-column ridge at alpha=10 under the sign rule. It closes nothing about forecast weather as a phenomenon -- see notes.
weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_si.description: Same run and same paired 1,537-game population as weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_probability_rule, scored under the predeclared SIGN rule (residual_at_open > 0) rather than the production probability rule. Baseline 52.83%, candidate 50.90%. Reported for comparability with prior opener-grade runs; the probability rule is the primary endpoint per docs/opener_evaluation.md.
weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_si.notes: Does NOT touch the registered pick-level forecast cells. forecast_weather_kn_warm_team_cold_late_full (+0.1686 accuracy points, week-blocked [+0.0091, +0.3169], P+ 0.9800) and its siblings are a different construction -- a narrow post-prediction pick-level tilt on ~1.5% of the slate -- and remain live as prospective challengers. This arm tested whether ridge extracts MORE from the raw continuous variables than those hand-coded cells do; it does not, on this population. Inferred mechanism, not measured: the market prices the same public forecast, so the columns mostly add variance to a market-residual model that is already near-sufficient, consistent with this project's own team-quality-is-already-priced finding. 142 picks flipped under the probability rule and the baseline was right on 55.8% of them versus the candidate's 44.2%, so the flips were actively harmful rather than neutral.
weak_stack_v4_forecast_weather_opener_si.plain_summary: Model setting: sign-rule scoring of the weather-forecast columns.

weather_oracle_ceiling_opener_probabilit.classification_evidence: Recorded category 3 DESPITE being a control arm, because the strict AGENTS.md ground is 'bounded by a positive control PROVEN ABLE to detect an effect that size', and this run proves no such detection capability -- it shows an absence, which is not the same thing. The week-blocked interval [-2.8170, +0.4610] contains zero, so no wrong sign is resolved either. What IS measured, and what makes this decision-relevant: the oracle arm (-1.131 pts) and the real-forecast arm weak_stack_v4 (-1.065 pts) are statistically indistinguishable, so the ORACLE-MINUS-FORECAST GAP is -0.066 accuracy points. That gap is the entire headroom available to better weather forecasting on this path, and it is approximately zero and slightly negative. Reliability is not_applicable: this is a whole-profile comparison, not a per-team trait with a year-over-year value to split-half.
weather_oracle_ceiling_opener_probabilit.description: POSITIVE-CONTROL arm: production weak_stack plus the weather that ACTUALLY happened (observed temp/wind, a forecast of infinite skill), vs the active weak_stack profile at the OPENER grade under the production probability rule. Deliberately leaky and never promotable; it exists to bound what ANY improvement in weather forecasting could be worth. Both arms hold ridge_alpha=10.0 and regressor=ridge fixed, on the same 1,537 paired Tuesday-opener games over 2020-2025, so the only difference from the weak_stack_v4 forecast arm is forecast skill. Baseline 53.3599%, oracle 52.2289%. Predeclared in docs/weak_stack_v4.md before scoring.
weather_oracle_ceiling_opener_probabilit.notes: Answers the owner hypothesis that the forecast arm failed because forecasting is not accurate enough. Measured, that is not the explanation: the kickoff-nearest archive has a median 6.0-hour lead time and temperature r=0.964 / MAE 3.25F against the observed value, and this arm shows that even PERFECT weather does not help. Wind is the leg where the hypothesis had teeth (r=0.649, MAE 3.16 mph at that same lead), and the oracle covers wind too -- so a better wind source has a measured ceiling of about -0.07 points on this construction. Scope: this is the FEATURE-vector construction only. It says nothing about the pick-level weather CELLS, which are a different construction on ~1.5% of the slate and remain ACTIVE_PROSPECTIVE challengers (forecast_weather_kn_warm_team_cold_late at P+ 0.9800, forecast_weather_kn_precip_high_total, forecast_cold_visitor_tilt). Coverage caveat: observed weather exists for 3,010 of 4,902 rows (61.4%) -- indoor games and unmapped stations have none -- so this is an oracle over the games that have an observation, with nulls imputed on the training fold like every other family.
weather_oracle_ceiling_opener_probabilit.plain_summary: Oracle: model handed the weather that actually happened.
